main.description: Renames a community's pack or replaces its emoji. Omitted fields stay as they are.

community.description: The community that owns the emoji.

pack.description: The pack's record URI in the community's repo.

description.description: The new description. An empty string clears it.

emojis.description: The full new list of emoji URIs, in order.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the community.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: PackNotFound
errors.description: No pack of this community exists at the given URI.

errors.name: EmojiNotFound
errors.description: No emoji of this community exists at the given URI.

errors.name: UnsupportedProvider
errors.description: The emoji provider is unknown, or it does not support the requested operation.

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.description: The pack name is empty or longer than 64 characters.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS call the AppView depends on failed.
